## Goals

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

- Find the least squares line, and read a and b in the units of the scores
- Predict a score, and find a residual
- Say what r² means
- Explain regression to the mean

- {{< fa book >}} The regression part of Chapter 14 in *Essentials of Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences* (to be confirmed)
